shape.text: The provider's authentication page says an API key is sent in the X-API-Key header. It states no prefix, length or example.

A key is the prefix PMAK-, 24 lowercase hexadecimal characters, a literal hyphen, then 34 lowercase hexadecimal characters: a 59-character body and 64 characters in all. Scanner rules agree on the structure, and one of them corroborates only the prefix and the 59-character body length.
The second segment is always 34 characters.

unresolved.reason: A research note records that 31 of 33 public-code candidates matched and none had a 35 or 36 character second segment, but the note is not a cited source; one unsourced proposal says the second segment is 34 to 36 characters.

shape.text: Postman's own agent redaction configuration describes the same 24 plus 34 hexadecimal structure.

unresolved.reason: The provider's own redaction configuration is described as fixing the same structure, but no source for it is cited in this family's contract.

shape.text: The hexadecimal segments may contain uppercase characters.

unresolved.reason: No source states whether uppercase hexadecimal is accepted.
